paragraphs: This is Tom. Tom is a boy. Tom has many toys. This is Pip. Pip is a puppy. Pip is Tom's puppy. Pip likes toys. Tom likes toys too. They are friends. Tom wants to sort toys. Tom has a big red ball. Tom has a small red car. Tom has a blue robot. Tom has a blue boat.

Tom has a green book. Tom has a green frog. Tom has yellow blocks. Tom has a yellow duck. Pip sees the toys. Many toys are on mat. Tom counts the toys. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight toys. Tom puts toys in boxes. This is a red box. Red ball is in red box. Red car is in red box. This is a blue box. Blue robot is in blue box.

Blue boat is in blue box. This is a green box. Green book is in green box. Green frog is in green box. This is a yellow box. Yellow blocks are in yellow box. Yellow duck is in yellow box. Tom sorts all toys. Pip is happy. Tom is happy. Good job, Tom! Good job, Pip! They play.
text.summary: Tom and his puppy Pip have many toys. Tom counts the toys: there are eight. Then he sorts them by color into a red box, a blue box, a green box, and a yellow box.
